name: circuit_breaker_guard
description:
Guard for LLM-proposed circuit-breaker state transitions as a single triage node.
The model proposes one typed transition (request_id, service_id, current_state,
proposed_state, error_rate, latency_p99_ms, open_duration_seconds); this workflow
owns the state-machine legality, the open/close error-rate and the half-open
probe-duration rules. Port of code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/circuit_breaker_guard.
Folding boundaries (documented, not computed in the DSL):
- JSON parsing details (required fields, dangerous-token rejection) fold into the
`proposal` choice.
- The fixed transition table {closed->open, open->half_open, half_open->closed,
half_open->open, any no-op} is a local fixture; the legality verdict folds into
the `transition` choice.
- The Python guard accumulates every error and joins the reasons; the ordered
ladder here reports the first failing check (which decides reject vs approve
identically), documented as a folding boundary.
Emitted labels: reject_proposal, reject_invalid_state, reject_illegal_transition,
reject_open_threshold, reject_half_open_duration, reject_close_error_rate, approve.

proposal.instructions: Does the model response parse as exactly one {request_id, service_id, current_state, proposed_state, error_rate, latency_p99_ms, open_duration_seconds} object (no dangerous tokens)?

criteria.malformed: parse error, missing field or dangerous token

state.instructions: Are both current_state and proposed_state in {closed, open, half_open}?

transition.instructions: Is current_state -> proposed_state an allowed transition (a no-op is always allowed)?

criteria.illegal: the transition is not in the allowed set

open_threshold.instructions: If proposed_state is open, is error_rate at or above the policy threshold (or force_open)?

criteria.below: opening while error_rate < threshold and not forced

half_open_duration.instructions: If proposed_state is half_open with min_open_duration > 0, is open_duration_seconds at or above the minimum?

criteria.ok: not half-opening, or below the min rule is satisfied
criteria.too_short: half-opening before the minimum open duration elapsed

close_error_rate.instructions: If proposed_state is closed, is error_rate at or below the policy close_error_rate_max?
